_help: Roles that a firm keeps posted all year on a careers page this project cannot read automatically (McKinsey, Bain). Each entry is typed in by hand from the firm's own public page, so it is not refreshed: update `checked` whenever you look again and delete an entry that is gone. Fields: company (exactly as in the firm database), title, url, location, description, mba (title | required | preferred, or null for a role outside the MBA tab), checked. Optional deadline (YYYY-MM-DD); a passed date hides the role by default.

roles.title: Associate (experienced hire)
roles.description: McKinsey's consulting Associate role: joins a client service team and owns a workstream. The posting asks for an advanced graduate degree (for example an MBA or PhD) or equivalent work experience. Standing posting listed for many offices; open the posting for the current office list. This is an experienced-hire opening, not the full-time MBA recruiting pipeline.

roles.title: Consultant (experienced hire)
roles.description: Bain's Management Consulting Consultant role (permanent, full-time), listed for offices across the Americas, Europe and Asia-Pacific. Experienced hires are considered year-round; check the posting for current offices. This is an experienced-hire opening, not the full-time MBA recruiting pipeline.
